title: docs(deployment): a marketplace handbook for app authors
body:
Fixes #27240

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增一页《Marketplace handbook for app authors》(`content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`)，从构建好的 `dist/objectstack.json` 讲到客户装上、升级、卸载；另加导航项与两处交叉链接。
- 为什么改：上架这一步（North Star 第④步「发布并装进一个环境」）的机制散在五页里，却没有一页告诉作者「上架清单由什么组成、客户管理员会遇到哪些界面」。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档，不发布任何包；回滚即 revert 本 PR。唯一的事实性改动是 `publish-and-preview.mdx` 里卸载那一句（旧句说必须重启才卸载干净，与 base 上的 DELETE 处理器不符）。
- 先看：① `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` 的「The customer's side」九步（每一步都对着 Console 文案或运行时路由核过）；② 同页 Callout「Two things the file can say that never reach the listing」；③ `publish-and-preview.mdx` 第 207-210 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm docs:dev` 后打开 `/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook`，预期左侧导航 Deployment 下出现 Marketplace Handbook，页内所有链接可点通。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New page** `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` (255 lines), sections in the order an author meets them: what a listing is (ADR-0019 D1/D2); the `objectstack.manifest.json` keys `os package publish` actually sends, with HotCRM as the example only for the keys it carries; `translations` for two locales; the README conventions (credentials as names, values supplied by the administrator); build and verify; publish, `--submit` and the three listing statuses the CLI prints; the customer's side in nine steps; staying current; dependencies vs build-time modules. Field lists are linked to the generated `content/docs/references/marketplace/*.mdx`, never restated.
- `content/docs/deployment/meta.json`: one nav entry.
- `content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx`: one Related link, plus the uninstall sentence corrected (in-place fix, evidence below).
- `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`: one Next steps card.
- `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`: regenerated by `node scripts/docs-audit/check-audit-scope.mjs --write` (+1 page). `check:docs-audit-scope` reds a new hand-written page that is not listed, so this file is a mechanical consequence of adding the page; it sits outside the claim's declared file surface.

How the premise correction on the claim was applied, point by point: no `pnpm verify` (the page names the scaffolded `validate` / `lint` / `typecheck` / `test` / `build` scripts and `os verify`); screenshots are stated as not carried by publish and not rendered by the Console, and the listing is built from icon plus two locales; HotCRM shown only for its own keys; credentials described as README prose, naming #27237 / #27238, with no env-var path; uninstall named as the Console action and `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId`, no CLI command; enable/disable named as the runtime surface with its real answer for an installed app; nothing about delisting or review internals; field lists linked.

**One measured divergence from the correction's wording, point 5 ("plus a restart").** At base the DELETE handler (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, `handleUninstall`, around lines 2243-2312) removes the ledger entry, then withdraws the package from the running kernel, removes the metadata copies, and runs the uninstall cleanups; its `note` says a restart is still owed only when a withdrawal step did not complete. The Console's own text agrees (`installedAdditiveNote`: "Uninstall removes the app from the running kernel at once"). The page therefore says the answer's `note` and `cleanups` tell whether anything stays loaded until restart, and `publish-and-preview.mdx`'s old "needs a restart to fully unload it, because app registration is additive" sentence is corrected to match.

Follow-up line, deliberately not in this PR (governed surface): `skills/objectstack-platform` gains one link line to `/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook`.

## Tests

Docs only: no package is touched, so no package test or typecheck is owed. Readings are on the final head `80f7e2df`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs build` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, "Compiled successfully", 1428 static pages; the rendered `marketplace-handbook.html` carries the page's key strings; the gen steps the build runs left the tree clean (`git status --porcelain` empty).
- `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs origin/main`: "0 docs name something this change touched (no anchors derived) across 0 changed package(s)" (the diff changes no package); `--all` lists the new page.

## Acceptance notes

- `objectstack.manifest.json` keys the schema accepts but publish never sends: `tags`, `publisher`, `isStarter` and `preview.*` parse under `TemplateManifestSchema`, and `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` reads none of them. HotCRM's manifest at `353dace` carries `tags`, `publisher` and `isStarter`. In the other direction publish reads and sends a top-level `tagline` that the schema does not declare (the non-strict object strips it on parse), and HotCRM also carries an undeclared top-level `engines`. The page warns about the first set and uses only `translations` for `tagline`. Reported for the PM's filing seat as a metadata-authoring trap.
- The CLI's listing-status hints read `pending_review`, while `ListingStatusSchema` in `packages/spec/src/marketplace/marketplace.zod.ts` enumerates `submitted` / `in-review`. The wire value is the control plane's (cloud); the page names only what the CLI prints.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-route-ledger.ts` row `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` still says "the kernel must restart to fully unload", which the handler no longer requires. Ledger prose, not served to anyone; noted, not changed.
- The page runs to 255 lines against the suggested 250.
